natural_body: SMB 40% discounts lifted acquisition and near-term revenue but cut retention 12%.

first.rationale: The two declining metrics (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point at the same funnel stage, and two inherited memories (memory_86 shortened onboarding, memory_31 signup field reduction) both claim durable lift there. That is my intended direction. But memory_86 and memory_31 are suspiciously similar in content and may be two consolidations of one underlying experiment, which would mean I have one data point, not two — so those are exactly the two records worth spending the verification budget on. I want the original records to check (a) whether they are independent, (b) whether the measured lift was activation-only or carried through to qualified revenue/retention, and (c) which fields were cut. I am deliberately not choosing promotional_pricing despite the competitor's entry pricing: memory_73 is the one inherited record with an explicit downside (40% SMB discount lifted acquisition but cut retention 12%), which directly contradicts the sustainable-long-term-revenue objective; matching a price war would likely buy volume and burn cohort value. Referral incentive (memory_57) targets established customers and does nothing for the two metrics that are actually falling. Enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) is credible but addresses a segment that is not the source of this quarter's decline. Downstream value risk: cutting signup/onboarding fields can degrade the data used for lead qualification and enterprise routing, so a lift in raw activation could show up as lower-quality pipeline later — I will instrument qualified-revenue and 30/90-day retention as guardrails, not just completion rate, and hold back the fields that feed the demo-request/sales-assist path from memory_44. Preserved uncertainty: all six memories are archived summaries from day 12-61, the competitive environment has changed since they were recorded, and the current declines may be caused by something these older experiments never tested (e.g. traffic-mix shift from the competitor pulling price-sensitive signups), in which case a funnel fix will underperform its historical effect size. If verification shows memory_86 and memory_31 collapse into one source, I would downgrade to small_guarded_test rather than change direction.
